'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Thanks for the help with the M4, you really helped me out. Unfortunately, this mercenary never transferred the payment he promised me. I trusted him because of old acquaintances, but the guy went straight to the lab as soon as he received the weapon, and so far there is no word from him. Got too greedy, that's my guess... Well anyway, I can deal with this matter later, but I also have something else on my mind. I'm collecting feedback on my services, looking for a fresh perspective, you know? I've decided not only to do individual orders, but to sell guns in sets, fully loaded out of the box. Test it out properly, ask your colleagues maybe. Every little detail and view point is important! And be sure to check the weapons in action, I'm sure you know how....}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate any 10 targets while using [[5.56x45mm NATO|5.56x45]] caliber weapons
* Eliminate any 10 targets while using [[5.45x39mm|5.45x39]] caliber weapons
* Eliminate any 10 targets while using [[7.62x39mm|7.62x39]] caliber weapons
* Eliminate any 5 targets while using [[7.62x54mmR|7.62x54R]] caliber weapons
* Eliminate any 5 targets while using [[9x19mm Parabellum|9x19]] caliber weapons
* Eliminate any 5 targets while using [[9x39mm|9x39]] caliber weapons

==Rewards==
* +20,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Mechanic]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.03'''</font>
* 1,500 Euros
** 1,575 Euros with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 1,725 Euros with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
{{quote|Hmm, I see. Pretty much what I expected, of course. Yet I still need more feedback... Anyway, I'll be in touch.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to eliminate 10 targets with any gun using the [[5.56x45mm NATO]] caliber, 10 with [[5.45x39mm]], 10 with [[7.62x39mm]], 5 with [[7.62x54mmR]], 5 with [[9x19mm Parabellum]] and finally 5 with [[9x39mm]].

'''Note:''' The [[MP-18 7.62x54R single-shot rifle]] doesn't count towards the progress with [[7.62x54mmR]].
